conceptual_clips.source: Gemini video, generated for this project on 27 October 2026
conceptual_clips.role: Abstract explanatory data-flow animation only; not measured CSI, RF propagation, a quantified missing rate or a model output

review: The generated video repair scene was excluded because crossing connectors do not faithfully explain per-stream linear interpolation.

display_edits.conceptual: Cream video background removed, foreground consistently recolored for each theme, exported as lossless animated WebP with alpha. Original opaque source clips retained as provenance.
display_edits.measured: Native plots rerendered with transparent canvas and theme-aware labels. The data, original scientific axes, interpolation and numerical results are unchanged.
display_edits.covers: Built-in reference-based alpha-background editing; typography/layout preserved. Decorative artwork only.
